fields.value: Demography in the province of Holland, 17th-19th centuries

dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset contains several files which have in common that they contain data on the historical demography of cities or regions in the Dutch province of Holland between the late seventeenth century and mid nineteenth century. These data mostly come from migration registers or census registers.
